# V4 — Multi-account AI Commerce Agent

**Key rules**
1. One internal `business_id` can own many Facebook/Instagram/WhatsApp accounts via `business_accounts`.
2. Meta GET + POST use the same `/webhook/meta-commerce` path.
3. Customer human request is decided by AI intent; handoff is SILENT: Sheet/DB update, no automated acknowledgement.
4. Any real manual Page reply switches that conversation to HUMAN, but bot echoes are ignored by saved Meta message IDs.
5. Google Sheet `Mode` can switch HUMAN ↔ AI.
6. Spam/AI usage guard runs before image/audio/LLM processing.
7. Price is always verified from Postgres product cache; never guessed.
8. OpenAI model node has no temperature option because some current models reject it.

Read the generated V4 guide before publishing.

**Reset safety (V4.1)**
- Reset is `$env`-free.
- Open `01.00 - Enter Reset Confirmation (EDIT BEFORE RESET)`.
- Temporarily set `reset_confirmation` to `RESET_AI_AGENT_DATABASE`.
- Run `01 - RESET - Entire AI Agent Database (DEV ONLY)`.
- After reset, restore the placeholder value.
- Running the guard directly without confirmation intentionally stops safely.

# Credentials after import
Select credentials manually for:
- Every Postgres node
- Every Google Sheets node
- OpenAI Chat Model - Core
- Analyze Product Image
- Transcribe Voice

Do not place real access tokens in the workflow JSON. Store Page/IG/WhatsApp tokens in `business_accounts`.

WITH prev AS (
  SELECT NULLIF(($4::jsonb #>> '{selected_product,productId}'),'')::bigint AS product_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT p.*,
    CASE
      WHEN p.id = (SELECT product_id FROM prev) AND length($2) < 60 THEN 3.0
      ELSE GREATEST(similarity(p.search_text,$2), similarity(lower(p.name),$2))
    END AS score
  FROM products p
  WHERE p.account_id=$1::bigint AND p.active=TRUE
  ORDER BY score DESC, p.updated_at DESC
  LIMIT 3
),
top_product AS (
  SELECT * FROM ranked ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 1
),
cached AS (
  SELECT rc.*
  FROM response_cache rc, top_product tp
  WHERE rc.account_id=$1::bigint
    AND rc.intent='PRODUCT_SEARCH'
    AND rc.product_id=tp.id
    AND rc.product_version=tp.content_hash
    AND (rc.expires_at IS NULL OR rc.expires_at > NOW())
    AND similarity(rc.normalized_question,$2) >= 0.92
  ORDER BY similarity(rc.normalized_question,$2) DESC, rc.updated_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  $3::jsonb AS base,
  COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(ranked) ORDER BY score DESC) FROM ranked),'[]'::jsonb) AS products,
  (SELECT id FROM top_product) AS top_product_id,
  COALESCE((SELECT content_hash FROM top_product),'') AS product_version,
  COALESCE((SELECT reply FROM cached),'') AS cache_reply,
  COALESCE((SELECT id FROM cached),0) AS cache_id;

WITH c AS (
  SELECT * FROM conversations WHERE id=$1::bigint FOR UPDATE
),
merged AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(c.context_json->'order_draft','{}'::jsonb) || $2::jsonb AS d,
         c.context_json,
         c.id
  FROM c
),
selected AS (
  SELECT NULLIF((SELECT context_json #>> '{selected_product,productId}' FROM c),'')::bigint AS product_id
),
candidate AS (
  SELECT p.*
  FROM products p
  WHERE p.account_id=$3::bigint
    AND p.active=TRUE
    AND (
      p.id=(SELECT product_id FROM selected)
      OR ($4 <> '' AND similarity(p.search_text,lower($4)) >= 0.25)
    )
  ORDER BY
    CASE WHEN p.id=(SELECT product_id FROM selected) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC,
    similarity(p.search_text,lower($4)) DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
final_draft AS (
  SELECT
    m.d ||
    CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM candidate)
      THEN jsonb_build_object(
        'product_id',(SELECT id FROM candidate),
        'product_name',(SELECT name FROM candidate)
      )
      ELSE '{}'::jsonb
    END AS d
  FROM merged m
),
upd AS (
  UPDATE conversations
  SET context_json=jsonb_set(context_json,'{order_draft}',(SELECT d FROM final_draft),true),
      state='ORDER_COLLECTING',
      updated_at=NOW()
  WHERE id=$1::bigint
  RETURNING *
)
SELECT
  $5::jsonb AS base,
  upd.context_json->'order_draft' AS draft,
  candidate.id AS verified_product_id,
  candidate.name AS verified_product_name,
  candidate.price AS verified_price,
  candidate.stock_qty AS verified_stock_qty,
  candidate.stock_status AS verified_stock_status
FROM upd
LEFT JOIN candidate ON TRUE;
